source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nitrogen cycle (PDF 232-234).

blocks.text: Nitrogen cycle woh amal hai jis se nitrogen ecosystem ke biotic aur abiotic hisson ke darmiyan ghoomti hai: hawa ki nitrogen (N2) zinda cheezon ke kaam ke compounds mein badalti aur baad mein hawa mein lotti hai. Yeh paanch qadmon se guzarti hai.

items: Nitrogen fixation: hawa 78% N2 hai jis ke atoms mazboot teen gane bond se jure hain jo paude nahi tor sakte; fixation N2 ko ammonia (NH3) jaise compounds mein badalti hai.

Nitrification: mitti ke bacteria ammonia, jo zyada miqdar mein zehreeli ya paudon ke liye mushkil hai, ko badalte hain: Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite (NO2-) aur Nitrobacter nitrite ko nitrate (NO3-) banata hai jise paude aasani se lete hain.
Assimilation: paude aur jaraseem nitrate le kar proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banate; janwar paude aur doosre janwar kha kar nitrogen lete hain.
Ammonification: jab jandar marte ya janwar nitrogen wala fuzla chhorte hain to decomposers (phaphoond aur bacteria) proteins tor kar organic nitrogen ko wapas ammonia banate hain.
Denitrification: paani bhari mitti mein Pseudomonas aur Thiobacillus jaise denitrifying bacteria nitrate ko wapas N2 banate jo hawa mein lotti hai.

blocks.caption: Nitrogen fix hone ke teen tareeqe
rows: mitti ke jaraseem: azad (cyanobacteria, Azotobacter, Clostridium) aur symbiotic (chana aur moong jaise phali daar paudon ki jarh ki gaanthon mein Rhizobium)
bijli ki chamak N2 ko oxygen se mila kar nitrogen oxides, phir nitrates banati
khaad ke liye N2 aur hydrogen mila kar ammonia

blocks.alt: Hawa ki nitrogen gas ko jarhon ki gaanthon (root nodules) aur mitti ke nitrogen-fixing bacteria fix kar ke ammonium banate hain. Paude janwaron (khargosh) ki ghiza; dono decomposer bacteria aur fungi tak jaate jo ammonium banate (ammonification). Nitrifying bacteria nitrites phir nitrates banate (nitrification). Nitrates paudon mein (assimilation) ya denitrifying bacteria se wapas nitrogen gas (denitrification).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bayen taraf hawa ki N2 do raaston se fix hoti hai: jarhon ki gaanthon ke bacteria aur mitti ke azad bacteria. Neeche ammonium se nitrites aur nitrates bante hain (nitrifying bacteria). Nitrates ya to paude le lete hain (assimilation) ya denitrifying bacteria unhein wapas N2 bana kar hawa mein bhej dete hain. Kitab mein 'fingi' chhapa hai; sahi lafz fungi hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Paani ka chakkar aisi cheez chalata hai jo nazar aati hai, jab ke nitrogen cycle aisi na-nazar aane wali gas se mutaliq hai jo hamari fiza ka taqreeban 78% hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisan chana jaise phali daar paude doosri faslon ke saath baari baari kyun ugate hain?
blocks.explanation: Un ki jarh ki gaanthon mein Rhizobium hawa ki nitrogen ko ammonia mein fix karta aur mitti ko kaam ki nitrogen se bharta hai.

items: Fixation (hayati >90%, bijli, sanat), nitrification, assimilation, ammonification, denitrification.
Nitrosomonas: NH3 se nitrite; Nitrobacter: nitrite se nitrate; Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus: nitrate se N2.
